subject.title: refactor: move MCP OAuth state to SQLite

question: Is the upgrade and credential-boundary evidence sufficient to accept the mandatory Doctor migration and removal of all runtime legacy-file fallback?
rationale: The architecture follows repository policy, but this stored credential migration intentionally changes existing upgrade behavior and the current PR body summarizes rather than exposes the live migration evidence needed to validate that boundary.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or log transcript covering fresh SQLite login and a legacy-file Doctor migration before approving the security-sensitive upgrade path.

options.title: Accept test-backed evidence
options.body: Approve the migration based on the focused tests, changed gate, source audit, and summarized smoke claim while explicitly owning the remaining real-upgrade uncertainty.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Hold the PR until the exact Codex contract and operational migration behavior can be reviewed together by the relevant owners.

recommendation.title: Require live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or log transcript covering fresh SQLite login and a legacy-file Doctor migration before approving the security-sensitive upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed migration design and are best positioned to provide or evaluate the missing live upgrade evidence.
